versus  GOVT.OF NCT OF DELHI AND ORS. ....
 Through: Mr. Nitin Mishra, Advoca  Mr. Siddharth Panda, Adv  Respondent No.3 / LAC.
 CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE V. KAMESWAR RAO  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANOOP KUMAR MENDIRATTA  ORDER % 09.02.2023 1.

Our attention has been drawn to the order dated April 25, 2022, which reads as under:-
"1. Grievance of the petitioner in the present petition is now limited to the extent that despite the writ petition having been allowed vide order dated 24th December, 2010 and respondent directed to pay compensation within one month, till date the compensation along with interest has not been remitted to the account of the petitioner.

2. Learned counsel for the respondent states that initial compensation has already been paid to the recorded owner of the petitioner who may only be entitled to enhanced compensation if at all, in which respect an affidavit will be filed.

3. A detailed affidavit will be filed by the respondent indicating as to whom the initial compensation was paid and whether the petitioner is entitled to any enhanced compensation along with interest if any, within two weeks.
Rejoinder thereto within one week thereafter.

4. List on 23rd May, 2022.
5. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court."

sentences.text:
A detailed affidavit has been filed by the LAC, Paragraph 8 thereof reads as under:-
"8.

That as per the guidelines/procedures prescribed by the competent authority from time to time, the application for release of compensation must accompany documents like title document, identity proof, indemnity bond, will/gift deed, any Court's orders including probate of will etc.
However, as on date no such application has been received from anybody in the office of the answering respondent.

Moreover,
in the present writ petition, the petitioner has prayed for lapsing of acquisition proceeding with respect to the land in question or in alternative, payment of compensation as per the provisions of Act, 2013.

In view of the Constitutional Bench judgment of Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in Indore Development Authority Vs.
Manoharlal. & Ors. S.L.P. (C) NOS.9036-9038 OF 2016 (2020 SCC OnLine SC 316)
dated 06.03.2020, the present writ petition be dismissed."

entities.text:

Manoharlal. & Ors. S.L.P. (C) NOS.9036-9038 OF 2016 (2020 SCC OnLine SC 316)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. Mr. N. K. Jain states, the only stand taken by the LAC in paragraph No.8 of the affidavit is that no application has been received in the Office of the LAC.

Mr. Jain states, a representation has been made to the L and B Department, which has forwarded the same to the LAC (South).
4.
Mr. N. K. Jain, on instructions, states, afresh representation shall be made to the LAC.

5. Noting the submission of Mr. Jain, the representation along with necessary documents be sent by the petitioner to LAC within one week from today and LAC shall consider and dispose of the same within six weeks of the receipt of representation and the decision thereof be communicated to the petitioner.
6. If petitioner has any grievance with regard to the order to be passed, liberty is with her to seek such remedy as is available in accordance with law.
7. Petition stands disposed of.

V. KAMESWAR RAO, J.
ANOOP KUMAR MENDIRATTA, J.
FEBRUARY 9, 2023/
